newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela and Iran restore diplomatic ties.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela and Iran restore diplomatic ties.

text.p: Venezuela and Iran have agreed to restore diplomatic ties, two and a half years after a spat which saw several Iranian embassy officials expelled, the Foreign Ministry said on Monday.
In a short release, the ministry said the two countries had decided to nominate ambassadors and resume diplomatic relations due to "the traditional bonds of friendship and common interest."
Venezuela expelled four mid-level Iranian diplomats in July 1994 for allegedly trying to kidnap a former Iranian government official and five members of his family seeking asylum.
Venezuela later declared the Iranian ambassador "persona non grata." The ambassador was recalled by Tehran and diplomatic ties between the two countries were broken off.
Venezuela and Iran are both members of the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC).
